mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, measure_time, systolic, diastolic, heart_rate FROM t_blood_pressure WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_blood_pressure (user_id, device_id, measure_time, systolic, diastolic, heart_rate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{measureTime}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{heartRate})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_blood_pressure SET user_id=#{userId}, device_id=#{deviceId}, measure_time=#{measureTime}, systolic=#{systolic}, diastolic=#{diastolic}, heart_rate=#{heartRate} WHERE id=#{id}
